==Eritrea==
Data from GSMA Intelligence shows that there were 1.58 million cellular mobile connections in Eritrea at the start of 2024.
GSMA Intelligence's numbers indicate that mobile connections in Eritrea were equivalent to 41.9 percent of the total population in January 2024.
The number of mobile connections in Eritrea increased by 122 thousand (+8.3 percent) between the start of 2023 and the start of 2024.<ref name="Digital 2024: Eritrea">{{cite web |url=https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2024-eritrea#:~:text=Mobile%20connections%20in%20Eritrea%20in,and%20the%20start%20of%202024.|title=Digital 2024: Eritrea |date=23 February 2024 |access-date=13 January 2025}}</ref>

In September 2010 the penetration rate was estimated at 3.4% over a population estimate of 5.9 million.<ref name="Eritrea Mobile Market (Q1 2008 - Q3 2010)">{{cite web |url=http://mnodirectory.com/ame/Eritrea.htm |title=Eritrea Mobile Market (Q1 2008 - Q3 2010) |access-date=10 November 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111204221038/http://www.mnodirectory.com/ame/Eritrea.htm |archive-date=4 December 2011 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

The telecom regulator in Eritrea is Eritrean Communications Regulatory Authority (ECRA).

==Ethiopia==
Data from GSMA Intelligence shows that there were 77.39 million cellular mobile connections in Ethiopia at the start of 2024.
GSMA Intelligence's numbers indicate that mobile connections in Ethiopia were equivalent to 60.4 percent of the total population in January 2024.
The number of mobile connections in Ethiopia increased by 8.2 million (+11.9 percent) between the start of 2023 and the start of 2024.<ref name="Digital 2023: Ethiopia">{{cite web |url=https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2023-ethiopia#:~:text=Mobile%20connections%20in%20Ethiopia%20in,percent)%20between%202022%20and%202023.|title=Digital 2023: Ethiopia |date=13 February 2023 |access-date=13 January 2025}}</ref>

In September 2010 the penetration rate was estimated at 4.6% over a population estimate of 90.8 million.<ref name="Ethiopia Mobile Market (Q1 2008 - Q3 2010)">{{cite web |url=http://mnodirectory.com/ame/Ethiopia.htm|title=Ethiopia Mobile Market (Q1 2008 - Q3 2010) |access-date=10 November 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111204221302/http://www.mnodirectory.com/ame/Ethiopia.htm |archive-date=4 December 2011 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

The telecom regulator in Ethiopia is Ministry of Communication and Information Technology (MCIT).

==Yemen==
In 2024 the penetration rate was estimated at 18% over a population estimate of 40 million.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Country Report for Yemen |url=https://pulse.internetsociety.org/en/reports/YE |access-date=2026-05-17 |website=Internet Society Pulse |language=en}}</ref> Because of unreliable coverage of mobile services in certain areas, particularly in rural areas, it is common for Yemenis to utilize a phone with [[Dual SIM]] capability.

The telecom regulator in Yemen is the Public Telecommunication Corporation.
